label: Extended Du Boisian racial sociology to apartheid South Africa
description: Applying empirical sociological inquiry to South African racial segregation, Meer analyzed how apartheid legal stratification fragmented Black and Indian communities.
dialecticalTension: Translates North American color-line sociology into anti-apartheid structural analysis.
historicalContext: University of Natal sociology and Durban anti-apartheid activism (1950s–1970s).

label: Mentored and supported Durban anti-apartheid and Black Consciousness circles
description: As a leading Durban sociologist and co-founder of the Black Women’s Federation, Meer collaborated with and championed Steve Biko’s Black Consciousness generation.
dialecticalTension: Bridges earlier non-racial anti-apartheid Congress politics with Black Consciousness.

citations.author: Fatima Meer
citations.work: Black Consciousness and South African Resistance
